clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Wrenix of Ratchet draws Horde rogues toward a goblin port far to the south. Zando'zan sends them to aid Wrenix the Wretched, a disreputable goblin in Ratchet.

In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, the rogue guild works out of winding crevices, largely unseen. Zando'zan, a troll who speaks in wild ramblings, greets operatives with ominous portents. His visions include Warchief Thrall struck down by poison and blade. He gives no explanation for the prophecy, and quickly sends agents south to the port town of Ratchet in the Barrens.

Ratchet lies on the Barrens coast, east of the Crossroads. Scoundrels, mercenaries, and tinkerers gather in the neutral port, where Wrenix the Wretched makes his home. Wrenix has little patience for Zando'zan's eccentric ways. He says the troll's earlier recruits met grim ends in the bay, among its hungry predators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Zando'zan has seen it! Yes, the day comes! Thrall's death... The dagger in his back, poison seeping through to his every vein... Zando'zan has said too much.
Friend! Zando'zan has a task for friend! Friend must travel to Ratchet, east of the Crossroads, and speak with Wrenix the Wretched. Go!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Another one? The last five that crazy troll sent me ended up as shark food. Let's hope you fare a little better, eh?
